notes: Sophos v0.7.2 (Beta) — real auto-updater trigger: the app checks the update feed on every launch (fire-and-forget) and shows a one-click banner when a newer version is available (download, Ed25519-verify, install, relaunch). Builds on the v0.7 conversation-first shell, automatic local-model detection, agent profiles with the Gauntlet baseline and Standard / Minimal / Creator / Code modes, the Trajectory event log, Code Mode's typed TypeScript tool SDK, and the v0.7.1 Profile Studio with export/import. 1118 unit tests. All versions before v1.0 are beta.
